rules: Health checks should be read-only and non-focus-disruptive whenever possible.
Model transport, request admission, execution and postcondition as separate health phases.
Model normal execution queue and scheduled lightweight control lane as independent health lanes with independent repair triggers.
Model direct pixel inspection and visual-QA campaign readiness independently from generic workstation execution health.

A terminal rejection before execution proves queue transport liveness only for the observation that produced that authenticated receipt; it does not prove execution readiness or continuing queue liveness.
A valid heavy normal-queue request may remain open without a receipt while workstation admission is deferred before durable intent; that state is not by itself transport failure.
The control lane is same-user limited scheduled recovery infrastructure, not a second persistent Python queue resident.
Control requests must remain bounded to the reviewed lightweight profile and five-minute request ceiling.
A component may repair only state it owns.
Self-heal must not silently cross a trust boundary such as hardware profile, identity, firmware, credentials or high-impact recovery authority.
Configured or historically proven authority does not imply current physical liveness.
A source snapshot must never be treated as current machine availability without fresh evidence.
A failed route or failed lane describes that route or lane only; it cannot prove the MSI or workstation is offline.
Before declaring local execution unavailable, evaluate all native EVAVO routes capable of the requested operation.
Before declaring browser pixel inspection unavailable, evaluate Computer Agent direct/retained visual routes and the independent Automated Testing visual-QA lane when QA evidence satisfies the task.
Desktop Commander is external fallback only and cannot define workstation health, gate local verification, gate screenshot inspection or gate visual QA.
Escalation to physical-console control requires evidence that narrower routes are unavailable or insufficient.
A successful process restart is not proof of end-to-end workstation recovery; downstream health must be re-observed.
While one route or lane is degraded, disable unsafe submissions through that route or lane without suppressing independent routes that remain eligible.
